changes: Optional review.py run --receipt checks/.../command.json records completed delegated process argv/cwd/returncode, normalized outer invocation, payload argv/expected cwd, elapsed time and receipt evidence directory.

Atomic no-clobber publication; reject traversal, symlinks and existing receipt before execution; publication errors preserve child exit and emit warning. No change to run_with_racket.py exec behavior.
Document receipt paths, completion boundary and interruption limits in existing START-HERE.md and top-level help.

checks.scope: Receipt option absent; existing no-receipt path passes.

checks.command: PYTHONPATH=src:shared/runtime python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_review_run_receipt.py tests/test_review_workspace_layout.py tests/test_review_storage_report.py tests/test_review_full_packet.py --junitxml=var/focused.xml

limits: Focused CPU wrapper/packet tests only; no generator batteries, model jobs, broad suite, or canonical/reference execution.
Receipt reports completion of the delegated launcher (which execs the payload after setup), not independent proof that payload started; payload cwd is explicitly expected, not observed.
Outer interruption can prevent a receipt; no heartbeat, detach, controller timeout/resume redesign, or external wrapper exit attestation.
No overwrite/export/scaffold overhaul, storage gates, source/rule guard changes, generator edits, retention hold edits, public/private identity changes or training admission.
Parent must apply patch against recorded preimages, verify own tree, then bind owner counter. Existing issued packets are unchanged.

request_dispositions.reason: Optional atomic run receipt implemented with focused isolated CPU probes. Records actual delegated child argv/cwd/returncode and explicitly labels payload cwd as expected launcher contract; setup failures cannot claim payload launch. Preserves existing exit/process behavior, stderr/stdout, source boundaries and evidence files. No semantic qualification claimed.

Existing baseline status already prints selected staged task-tests command; RETURN-GUIDE explains raw pytest lacks generated namespace. No arbitrary raw-import interception added in bounded maintenance; staged path remains supported.
Existing run_with_racket.py already provides packet-local src and shared/runtime PYTHONPATH. Direct probe invocation/template audit remains open; no generator import or scaffold overhaul implemented.
